minesecGuide.title: MINESEC payment guide (cartescolaire.cm)
minesecGuide.intro: Your school uses the national unique-matricule system. Here's how to pay official fees.
minesecGuide.step1: Get your child's national matricule on cartescolaire.cm (name + school), if not already known.
minesecGuide.step2: Top up your Mobile Money account, then dial the USSD code of your chosen operator (below) and follow the prompts.
minesecGuide.step3: Enter the child's matricule when asked, and check that their name displays correctly before confirming payment.
minesecGuide.step4: Wait 48h, then download the official receipt directly from cartescolaire.cm — it's the only valid receipt, keep it.
minesecGuide.operatorsList: MTN MoMo (*126*007#) · Orange Money (#150*41#) · CAMPOST Money · Express Union (#237*333#) · Afriland First Bank
minesecGuide.receiptNote: Only receipts downloaded from cartescolaire.cm are valid — even after paying with the operator, wait 48h before downloading it.
minesecGuide.examNote: This system also covers official exam fees (BEPC, Probatoire, BAC, GCE...) and the entrance exam to 6ème — same matricule, same process.
